'''Protector Dragon Armor''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Armor]] set that is focused on {{Stat|Defense}}. Its {{fsb}} grants extra {{Stat|def}} as {{Stat|hp}} is lost. The full set can be crafted from {{Item|Protector Dragon Fragment|amount=240}}s and is one of 8 different [[Dragon Armors|Dragon Armor]] sets.

{{Skl|Combat|16}} (XVI) is required to be able to use this set and, if a dungeon item, {{skl|Catacombs|12}} (XII) to be able to use this set while in [[Dungeons]].

== Tips ==
*If one wants to complement its stat specialty, the {{ReforgeLink|Titanic}}, {{ReforgeLink|Reinforced}}, {{ReforgeLink|Perfect}} or {{ReforgeLink|Giant}} [[reforge]] is recommended to get {{stat|hp}} and/or {{stat|def}}.
* Protector Dragon Armor is considered by many as the worst out of the [[Dragon Armors|Dragon Armor]] sets, as it performs poorly for damage and provides less health compared to other Dragon sets.
* Players will find Holy Dragon Armor to be the better choice instead, as Holy Dragon Armor provides superior stat boosts and is much cheaper.

== Trivia ==
* The {{Stat|Effective Health}} of this armor depends on the amount of damage taken at once, as the {{Stat|def}} bonus is calculated based on the instantaneous {{Stat|hp}} remaining. 
*When the player is on very low {{Stat|hp}}, this armor set provides almost as much {{Stat|def}} as Tier X [[Perfect Armor]].
